headline: Reagan in 1982: interest rates had climbed to *21.5%*
quote: Interest rates had climbed as high as 21.5 percent
title: When US interest rates hit 21.5% (Reagan, 1982)
caption: October 1982: President Reagan says inflation was 12.4% in 1980 and interest rates had climbed as high as 21.5%. Mortgage rates topped 18% in 1981.
context: The prime rate hit 21.5% in Dec 1980. Today: *{fred:DPRIME:1:2}%*.
comment: Could you afford a mortgage at 18%? 👇
